engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connector(s) from/to Wiper Switch for Intermittent Operation (E22) faulty
Wiper Switch for Intermittent Operation (E22) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connector(s) from/to Wiper Switch for Intermittent Operation (E22)

Kontrol edin:  Wiper Switch for Intermittent Operation (E22)
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Golf/Jetta/Bora (1K/5M) (and similar): Steering Wheel, Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Blocks (MVB) 001.4 & 002.1.
This fault does NOT mean the Wiper Switch/Lever itself, it means the small Switch for the Interval on top of it!
